title: T08 vertex memory and initial polygon loader contract

modules.name: initial_polygon_rom

ports.name: read_data_o
ports.description: Packed signed Q16.16 X then Y vertex

behavior: Load 720 packed vertices from the frozen T02 memory file.
Return one registered read response one clock after each enabled in-range request.
Return zero data for addresses 720 through 1023.
constraints: Each word packs signed Q16.16 X in bits 63:32 and signed Q16.16 Y in bits 31:0.
corner_cases: Out-of-range addresses return zero with a valid response.
verification_cases: Read all 720 words through the loader and compare bit-exactly with the T02 memory image.

timing_diagrams.title: Synchronous vertex ROM read
timing_diagrams.description: A request produces registered data and valid on the following clock.

modules.name: vertex_ram_dual_buffer

ports.name: port_0_buffer_i
ports.description: Port 0 buffer A or B selection

ports.name: port_1_buffer_i
ports.description: Port 1 buffer A or B selection

behavior: Provide two logical 1024 by 64-bit vertex buffers selected independently by each port.
Map the buffer selector to physical address bit 10 of one 2048 by 64-bit single-clock true-dual-port Block RAM template.
Each port performs one synchronous read or write per enabled clock.
Read responses are registered and valid for one clock.
constraints: Do not access one physical address from both ports in the same cycle when either port writes; same-address read/write and dual-write results are undefined.
Memory contents are not cleared by reset; only read outputs and valid flags reset.
corner_cases: Concurrent access to different buffers is independent.
Concurrent writes to different addresses of one buffer are supported.
verification_cases: Write and read different buffers concurrently.
Write distinct addresses in one buffer concurrently and read them back through opposite ports.

timing_diagrams.title: Concurrent dual-buffer reads
timing_diagrams.description: Both ports independently return a registered vertex.

modules.name: initial_polygon_loader

ports.name: target_buffer_i
ports.description: Zero selects buffer A and one selects buffer B

ports.name: ram_write_enable_o
ports.description: Write one ROM response into vertex RAM

behavior: Capture the target buffer and stream ROM addresses 0 through 719 on consecutive clocks.
Align each synchronous ROM response with the corresponding RAM address.
Complete the final write and assert done 721 cycles after accepting start.
constraints: The RAM write interface must connect to one write-capable port of vertex_ram_dual_buffer.
The target buffer remains constant for the entire load.
corner_cases: A busy-time start emits one protocol error pulse and cannot change the target buffer.
The count becomes 720 with the same edge that asserts done.
verification_cases: Load and compare all 720 vertices into buffer A.
Load and compare all 720 vertices into buffer B while confirming buffer A is preserved.
Check fixed latency, count, single-cycle done, and busy-start rejection.

timing_diagrams.title: Pipelined initial polygon load
timing_diagrams.description: After startup, ROM responses generate consecutive RAM writes through the final vertex.
